criteria.evidence: Opens with identifying which boundary fails (retrieval vs generation), diagnoses whether chunk was retrieved, ignored, or cut off, and covers chunking/context formatting and generation fixes; measures retrieval separately from answer quality.
criteria.criterion: Trace retrieval, context construction, and generation boundaries.

criteria.evidence: "Find which boundary is failing before changing anything"; take 20-50 real failing queries, tally buckets, "Without this you're guessing"; defers fine-tuning, multi-agent, knowledge graphs until diagnosis shows a gap.

Separates retrieval from answer quality and says change one thing at a time, and checks retrieved chunks per query, but never proposes an explicit isolation experiment such as feeding gold passages directly to the model to test generation independent of retrieval.
criteria.criterion: Use an isolation experiment where appropriate.
